workLeave.title: Leave
workLeave.description: Balances, requests and Earned Leave. Requests go to your manager first, then to HR.

apply.title: Apply for leave
apply.description: Weekly offs and approved holidays are not counted. Your manager decides first, then HR.
apply.halfHint: Half days apply to a single date only.
apply.unpaidTitle: Your balance does not cover every day
apply.unpaidBody: Your available balance is {available} day(s); {shortfall} day(s) would be unpaid.
apply.unpaidConfirm: I understand that {n} day(s) will be unpaid.

el.title: Earned Leave
el.description: Earned Leave is credited automatically after enough eligible working days.
el.disabled: Earned Leave is switched off in the policy.
el.progressBar: Eligible days towards the next Earned Leave credit
el.toNext: {n} more eligible day(s) until the next credit of {credit} day(s).
el.noCreditsBody: A credit appears here, with the exact days that earned it, once the requirement is met.

reason.CARRIED_OVER: Carried over from the previous period

requests.emptyBody: Apply for leave and follow its approval here.
requests.cancelBody: If it was approved, the days go back to your balance. Leave that has already started cannot be cancelled.

ledger.emptyBody: Credits, leave taken and corrections appear here, newest first. Nothing is ever edited or deleted.

calendar.title: Next 60 days
calendar.description: Only people you are allowed to see are listed. Reasons are never shown.

errors.dateOrder: The end date is before the start date
errors.halfDaySingle: A half day applies to a single date

workApprovals.title: Leave approvals
workApprovals.description: Requests wait for the manager step first and then for HR. You cannot decide your own request.
workApprovals.emptyPendingBody: New requests appear here and you are notified.
workApprovals.approveBody: Approving the HR step debits the balance. Approving the manager step sends it on to HR.
workApprovals.rejectBody: A rejection ends the request and the employee is told why.

workBalances.title: Leave balances
workBalances.description: See any employee's balances, Earned Leave progress and history. Adjustments are permanent, need a reason and are audited.
workBalances.pickHint: Choose an employee to see their balances.
workBalances.adjustBody: A new ledger entry is added; existing entries are never changed. You cannot adjust your own balance.
workBalances.amountHint: Use a minus sign to remove days, for example -1 or 0.5.

errors.badAmount: Enter a non-zero number with at most 2 decimals
